## Flagship Projects
1. **Agentic FacilityOps AI Platform**:
   - Description: Enterprise autonomous multi-agent building intelligence system monitoring energy, maintenance, occupancy, and cost with 1-minute streaming telemetry.
   - Stack: Next.js 16, FastAPI, PostgreSQL (Neon), Scikit-Learn, Pandas, Groq LLM, Clerk.
   - Live: https://facilityops-platform.vercel.app
   - GitHub: https://github.com/krbipin/Agentic-FacilityOps-AI-Platform

2. **SwasthyaAI: Diabetes Risk Predictor**:
   - Description: Healthcare machine learning diagnostic system evaluating 8 clinical parameters with zero-latency inference.
   - Stack: Python, Scikit-learn, Streamlit, NumPy, StandardScaler.
   - Live: https://diabetes-predictor-muqth3gs8dfgsg9ea2wqz3.streamlit.app/
   - GitHub: https://github.com/krbipin/diabetes-predictor

3. **RAG-Powered Document Q&A System**:
   - Stack: LangChain, ChromaDB, Sentence Transformers, Groq LLM, FastAPI, React.
   - Latency: <300ms semantic search across multi-format documents.

4. **Hybrid Movie Recommendation System**:
   - Stack: Scikit-learn, SVD Matrix Factorization, TF-IDF, React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB.
   - Metrics: Evaluated on MovieLens 1M dataset, achieving 0.87 RMSE.

5. **Customer Churn Prediction Dashboard**:
   - Stack: XGBoost, SMOTE, SHAP Values, FastAPI, Streamlit, React.
   - Metrics: 92% AUC-ROC with local and global explainability.

6. **Real-Time Sentiment Analysis Pipeline**:
   - Stack: HuggingFace BERT, PyTorch, ONNX Runtime (3x inference acceleration), Express, React.
   - Metrics: 91% F1-score.
